model_interpretation.claim: The selected multiply-reduction SWAR parent is the best measured candidate (81.7 microseconds). After the nibble-count stage, each byte holds a count from 0 to 8. Summing the low-byte pair and high-byte pair independently, then combining them, may shorten the dependent reduction chain compared with multiply-and-extract, though the extra shifts and additions may offset that benefit. This tests only the reduction while retaining exact uint32 population counts and the ordered recurrence; performance must be measured.
